actions.action: Free changes and cancellations for bookings in a 2-week window

decisions.message: Workers at our ground handling contractor plan a 48-hour strike in Orlando and Philadelphia on December 22-23. Some flights may be late or canceled. If you fly with us between December 14 and 27, you can change or cancel your booking free of charge in the app now. We will keep you updated by text.
decisions.why:
Tell people two weeks early, honestly.
Give them control: move the trip at no cost.
Spend little; keep budget for surprises.

actions.action: Goodwill for affected passengers, up to 10,000 passengers
Double loyalty points for affected passengers

decisions.message: If your flight was canceled or delayed more than 3 hours during the December 22-23 strike, we are adding a $75 Kestrel travel credit and double loyalty points for that trip to your account. We are sorry for the disruption to your holidays. Refunds for canceled or significantly delayed flights are still available in the app.
decisions.why:
Repair trust after the strike, before people book again.
Credits cost little: most fill seats that would fly empty.
Apology plus a concrete reason to come back.

customer_mix._note: TEAM ASSUMPTION, share of Kestrel passengers by group (no public split: research section 5 [GAP]). Dossier: 'Price-conscious travelers: families visiting relatives, students, vacationers, and some small business travelers' plus agencies booking group tickets. Families first (holiday season, Christmas week 97% booked), vacationers next, students on winter break, 'some' business, agencies small but each books a whole group. Shares are passengers, not bookings. Each persona weighs its group's share split evenly over that group's personas.
